title: Vim Wilds free practice sample buffers

fileName.description: A bare file name with no path separator. This is the value `%` and `Ctrl-r%` will read once the file-name register lands.

languageId.description: Must resolve to a profile in language-profiles.json.

summary.description: One line describing the buffer. Renders inside a 360px picker row.

lines.description: Long enough that :g, macros, and bulk substitution have something to bite on, short enough to stay a scratch file.

items.description: At most 34 columns. The free practice slab exposes 296px of text column at 360px wide, which is 35.2 monospace characters at 14px; the horizontal axis is unreachable by touch because .game-area pins touch-action to pan-y.
